description: The earlier approved CLS-022 restricted negatively oriented items to negation, interrogatives or conditionals and excluded all positive assertions, but Chapter 13 §1.1 pp. 1101 supplies affirmative scalar and non-scalar comparatives licensing some such items.
proposed_resolution: Approved and implemented: expand CLS-022 to recognise the three licensed comparative categories for negative-polarity senses while retaining separate restrictions for other affirmative clauses, free-choice any, and non-scalar same ... as constructions.
approval: Explicit user approval in this Chapter 13 request
